company.summary: NORTØMMER AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under engroshandel med tømmer, trelast, byggevarer og sanitærutstyr (NACE 46.830), based in Elverum, founded 1998-05-29. Its verified website describes it as: “På skogeierens side NORTØMMER kjøper tømmer til gode priser over hele Norge. Vi er heleid av NORSKOG, og arbeider for økt konkurranse i markedet. Vårt mål er best mulig betingelser for skogeieren. For skogeiere” Public brand: Nortømmer. Registered activity: Kjøp og salg av tømmer med tilgrensende virksomhet. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 3.2 bn, operating result NOK -17.7 m, net result NOK -11.9 m, total assets NOK 386.2 m, equity NOK 93.7 m. The period closed with a loss. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 2.4 bn to NOK 3.2 bn (+34%); net result went from NOK 28.8 m to NOK -11.9 m; equity went from NOK 103.3 m to NOK 93.7 m (-9%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin -0.6%; equity ratio 24.3%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 74. Leadership in the official register: Per Kveseth (managing director); Arne Rørå (chair of the board); Erik Tømmeraas Veiby (board member); Tone Margrethe Reierselmoen (board member); plus 5 further roles. 5 registered workplaces in Elverum, Hønefoss, Randaberg, Skien, Sperrebotn. Official website https://nortommer.no/ (identity check: labelled organisation number); company-linked profiles on instagram. Latest company-published activity: “Fordeling av midler fra Landbrukets utviklingsfond” (2026-11-10). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
